Portrait 9:16 luxury hand-painted pastel watercolor anime wedding film. The SAME adult Indian Ashok Kumar and Supriya with consistent faces, ivory linen jacket and pearl-white dress are together at the SAME quiet beach at night. They stand very close behind the SAME single ivory invitation card on the SAME linen-draped table. Their heads lean together gently; joined hands are visible beside the card. Daisy, blush silk ribbon, softly blurred sea horizon, tiny distant warm lanterns and a narrow moonbeam. Exactly ONE card; no other boards or signs. The card is face-on and fills the lower central two-thirds with generous blank margins, detailed rose-gold hairline edge and delicate watercolor blossoms. Print these two text groups clearly on its clean face in elegant dark slate-blue editorial serif, no words from the previous wedding-details face: "From a profile in a classroom
to a life in our hands —
we found forever." and, beneath a wide gap, "SAVE THE DATE
6 & 7 FEBRUARY 2020". Preserve the exact words, punctuation, date and order. Both adult faces visible softly above card, emotionally intimate and still. Luxury cinematic lighting, fine drifting paper-light flecks, natural hands, no watermark, no extra text.
